selectionBoundary.criteria: Official first-party sources from a representative set of frontier-model developers, cloud/model providers, and public or nonprofit evaluation and science infrastructures, selected only to identify common evidence, safety, privacy, interoperability, and reproducibility needs.
selectionBoundary.knownGaps: This initial English-language snapshot is geographically and institutionally narrow. It does not yet provide systematic coverage of regulators, worker representatives, customers, compute and energy suppliers, biotech or pharmaceutical partners, wet labs, or additional global and AI-for-science institutions.
selectionBoundary.exclusionMeaning: Absence is not a judgment of frontier status, importance, safety, quality, eligibility, or willingness to participate. Future inclusion requires the same official-source and export, sanctions, privacy, safety, and non-endorsement review.

contentPinning.reason: The official locators are mutable and their served representations were not archived into this repository. URL, supported claim, ISO publication or effective date when known, page state at retrieval, retrieval date, and review deadline are recorded; every source must be revalidated before active use.
